newsitem.title: USA: CRI shareholders ok liquidation plan.
newsitem.headline: CRI shareholders ok liquidation plan.

text.p: CRI Liquidating REIT Inc said Wednesday that its plan of liquidation and dissolution was approved by shareholders at today's special shareholder meeting.

The plan was approved by both shareholders holding a majority of the company's outstanding stock and by shareholders holding a majority of the outstanding stock exclusive of shares held by CRIIMI MAE Inc.

Under the plan, the company said it will completely liquidate and voluntarily dissolve in accordance with the laws of the State of Maryland. It will promptly file articles of dissolution with the state and will continue to exist only for purposes of winding up its business affairs.

The stock transfer books of the company will be permanently closed upon acceptance of the articles of dissolution by the state, and holders of record as of that date will be entitled to receive the final liquidating distribution.
